notes.title: Dragoneer’s Advent Update
notes.content:
[b]A new era begins today[/b], Dragoneers—a chance to prove yourself, to rise, and to claim what’s yours.

We are thrilled to unveil the[b] details of today’s major update[/b]!

It introduces:[list]
[*] A new [u]FREE progression system[/u] with a dedicated menu and an impressive set of 50 new rewards to unlock
[*] [u]Changes to the Quests structure[/u], including a new menu
[*] [u]UI Improvements[/u] & Adjustments
[*] [u]Balancing changes[/u] to the PvP sandbox
[*] Exciting new shop items
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]

[h1]New Dragoneer Level progression system[/h1]

The Dragoneer Level is a brand-new progression system that will now serve as your main level in the game. It’s a [b]single unified progression path[/b], free for all players, designed to reward your performance, time, and dedication across various game modes.

Importantly, [b]the Dragoneer Level does not replace the current Dragon Pass[/b]. Instead, it works alongside it, allowing you to progress through both systems simultaneously. Play matches, complete quests, earn XP, and claim rewards as you reach each new level.

We have already teased a few rewards coming with the Dragoneer Level system - now it’s time to show you a few more:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322267/57baa9a3f9069ebdd8b624ac8e3e56070dbcc668.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322267/e8e78b941c6f8458c078ac026bcba320669c47eb.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322267/52d3d3c953bb1391c5b0bbd317444df9f19b2b11.png[/img]


[h1]Quests Restructuring[/h1]

The Quests menu, which was previously part of the [b]Dragon Pass tab[/b], has now been [b]moved to its own dedicated section[/b] and introduces an updated structure for [b]weekly quests[/b].

Previously, weekly quests were cumulative and shared across all players. To put all players on equal footing, [b]they now reset each week and are randomized for each player[/b], similar to how daily quests currently work. Daily and Weekly Objectives still remain to get some nice chunks of XP to level up the Dragoneer Level and the Dragon Pass.

As a result of these changes:
[list]
[*] The “Quests” sub-tab has been removed from the Dragon Pass tab
[*] The new Quests Menu can now be accessed directly from the Main Menu - as it was before - but with an improved interaction area for mouse users
[*] The Treasure Quest can also been seen in the Quests Menu
[*] And speaking of the Treasure Quest, it can be progressed during the week instead of only weekends!
[*] The previously assigned shortcut key for opening the Quests menu will now open the “Dragoneer Level” menu instead
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322267/f2382ba39a0cd9b44b21cc5669efa05011362792.jpg[/img]


[h1]UI Improvements & Adjustments[/h1]

[u][b]Main Menu[/b][/u]

Main Menu has received a few not significant, but still noticeable, adjustments that you will see right after launching the game. These changes include:
[list]
[*] The[b] top-right level progression section now displays your Dragoneer Level [/b]instead of your Dragon Pass. As a result, all players will see Level 1 there after updating the game. Your Dragon Pass level will now be shown in a separate section below.
[*] The [b]"Dragon Pass" section has been more visually separated[/b] from the Quests section and now includes: An icon representing your current Dragon Pass level and a progression bar with accompanying text showing how much XP is needed to reach the next level.
[*] [b]Your Dragon Pass level icon [/b]is now also visible next to its corresponding tab in the top navigation menu.
[*] The [b]"Quests" section[/b] now shows a reset timer for all three quest types.
[*] The [b]Leaderboard shortcut[/b] has been removed from the Main Menu. You can still access the Leaderboard through the Ranked section of the “Play” tab.
[*] The [b]"XP Boosters" section[/b] has been moved to the left side of the screen, just below the "Play" button, with a slight UI redesign.
[*] The [b]"Treasure Chests" section[/b] has been slightly lowered as a result of the above changes.
[/list]

                                                                                    (Before)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322267/d3a960a4ecddcae5dee8dcddf1fbb89780b90bf0.jpg[/img]
                                                                                    (After)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322267/783ae2f71a9ac4c5ad5774dea0fea19780caade8.jpg[/img]


[u][b]Profile Menu[/b][/u]

In line with the new progression system changes to the Main Menu, [b]the Profile Menu now includes a dedicated Dragoneer Level section, alongside the existing Dragon Pass section[/b].

This new section will display the following:
[list]
[*] Your current Dragoneer Level icon with a progress bar
[*] Text indicating how much [b]XP is needed[/b] to reach the next level
[*] A preview of the [b]reward[/b] you will earn upon leveling up
[*] A [b]"Rewards" button[/b], which replaces the former [b]"More Info"[/b] button and redirects you to the [b]“Dragoneer Level”[/b] menu
[/list]
Additionally, your [b]Dragon Pass level icon[/b] will now appear next to the [b]current season title[/b] for better visibility.

                                                                                   (Before)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322267/a8a8904a4d33e75324b1c7e1a4e6a68e41bcb002.jpg[/img]
                                                                                   (After)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322267/25a60fd91b1b695c18e10ea5e97acda9d5299f5b.jpg[/img]


[u][b]New “Dragoneer Level” Menu[/b][/u]

This new menu is dedicated exclusively to display all Dragoneer Level rewards. You can access it two ways:
[olist]
[*] Proceed to Profile Menu and select “Rewards”
[*] Select “Dragoneer Level” section in top right corner which is now interactable
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322267/bf7d5f1af6e3f7d1df3e093dae97bae9a6ae88e5.jpg[/img]


[u][b]XP Distribution Screen[/b][/u]

This screen has experienced 2 changes:
[olist]
[*]  Added a new Dragoneer Level progression section with its related information and rewards
[*]  Rewards obtained by leveling up in the Dragon Pass or the Dragoneer Level will be displayed after the complete XP Distribution.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322267/b8943b8e800bbe3da93f717864a11d285523de82.jpg[/img]


[h1]Balancing[/h1]

Key balancing adjustments will be made to ensure a fairer and more dynamic battlefield. 

[u][b]Phantom:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Reduced Health back to 75.

[/list]
[u][b]Rimeblood:
[/b][/u]
Hallowed Hailstorm (Power):[list]
[*] Reduced Movement Debuff duration to enemies from 2.5s to 1s after exiting the trail.
[*] Reduced Damage Buff duration to allies from 10s to 8s after entering the trail.
[*] Duration is unchanged when hitting allies directly with the blast at the trail’s end.
[/list]
Hallowed Blizzard (Rage):
[list]
[*] Reduced Movement Debuff duration from 6s to 3s.
[*] Reduced Damage Buff duration to allies from 15s to 12s.
[/list]

[u][b]Marauder:[/b][/u]

Relentless Predator (Passive):
[list]
[*] Kills and assists on players now grant a partial recharge of Power and Ability instead of fully recharging them.
[/list]
Gust (Ability):
[list]
[*] Increased cooloown from 15s to 17s.
[/list]

[u][b]Stormraiser:[/b][/u]

Chain Lightning (Power):
[list]
[*] Reduced cooldown from 30s to 26s.
[*] Reduced Stamina block duration from 4s to 3s.
[*] Reduced range of lightning bounces by roughly 10%.
[*] Reduced damage of lightning bounces from 20 to 15.
[/list]

[u][b]Blast (Ability):[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Reduced cooldown from 25s to 22s.
[*] Change applies to both Phantom & Windguard.
[/list]


[h1]New shop content![/h1]

With the launch of the Dragoneer’s Advent update, take flight with a new Galestrider: “[b]Alterius, Peerless Hunter[/b]”! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322267/a1e6c348eccae5dc2e487480ff4a3d82d39c9d36.png[/img]

Other packs & dragons will be available in the coming weeks, but we’ll keep them as a surprise for now. Do not miss the chance to get them!


[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed a rare case where some dragons are invisible during Preview screen
[*] Multiple minor fixes with different localizations
[/list]
[h3]
Forge your legacy. The skies await![/h3]



[h1]FAQ[/h1]

[b]Question: [/b]How do I earn XP for my Dragon Pass now after Dragoneer Level was introduced?
[b]Answer:[/b] You will earn XP in same way as always but now the XP you get from the match will be also added to both progression bars/systems.

[b]Question:[/b] How many quests will be available for completion each week?
[b]Answer:[/b] Each week, you will have access to 6 Daily Quests, 7 Weekly Quests, and 3 Weekly Objectives to complete for each.

[b]Question: [/b]Can I use XP Boosters to speed-up my progress in the Dragoneer Level?
[b]Answer: [/b]Yes, XP Boosters can be used to gain additional XP.

[b]Question: [/b]How many levels will the Dragoneer Level have?
[b]Answer: [/b]It starts with 50 levels and each of them offers a reward. We will be adding more in the future.

notes.title: Double XP Weekend & Sales

[h1]Double XP event [/h1]

It’s time to get back into the arena and focus on your progression through all the available game modes with a new Double XP Event!

notes.title: Infernal Chase (06/06 - 27 /06)
notes.content:
[h2][b]Infernal Chase 🔥
[/b][/h2]
From now on until June 27th, take part in a special Gates of Fire event, introducing the new Event Pass feature. Prove your worth and complete a set of various objectives to receive mighty rewards!

[h2][b]Event Pass new feature
[/b][/h2]
This Infernal Chase edition marks the introduction of the very new Event Pass feature, allowing you to access a “mini Dragon Pass” for the duration of the event in exchange for 500 Gems. Regular rewards stay the same as before, but Event Pass gives access to additional ones.

Here is a detailed list of how Event Pass works:

- Collect Medals as you complete regular event objectives
- By buying the Event Pass, you will be able to spend your Medals to unlock cosmetics and currencies (Legendary and Epic Dragons, Gems, Coins, Gears, Profile items…)
- Medals count will reset at the end of the event, so make sure to spend it before 
- You can spend their Medals as you like, unlocking the rewards in the order you want

notes.content:
[h2]Halloween Event 🎃
[/h2]

[i]An endless night falls on the Aldrün Sanctuary, and now the restless spirits of beasts and warriors haunt the sacred burial grounds. Fight in this graveyard of souls yearning for another battle, earn rewards by completing Event Objectives, and compete in the Leaderboard for more![/i]

- 12/10 to 19/10: Gates of Fire 
- 19/10 to 26/10: Kingslayer
- 26/10 to 02/11: Plunder

Event will begin and end at 9:00 UTC.

[h2]New Dragon breed: Cloudsplitter ☁️
[/h2]
"Throughout centuries, there have been several accounts of a one-of-a-kind animal sharing the same traits as the numerous dragons that roam the land: Sizeable wingspan, incredible speed, piercing talons, and the capacity to carbonize a small hamlet in minutes. Some believe its appearance marks the dawn of a new age, while others think this continent could use less egg-laying, fire-breathing creatures."

Will you succeed in taming Cloudsplitters?

In addition to the new Dragon breed, a bunch of new items have been added into the Shop section, including an undead Dragon... Check it out!

notes.title: Double XP & Plunder events
notes.content:

From now on until Friday 1st September, 9:00:00 UTC, compete in a variant of Spoils of War and get rewarded for your courage!

[b]In Plunder, Gold Carriers do not respawn. However, both teams can risk daring heists as gold can be stolen directly from the enemy coffers.[/b]

Manage to secure a place in the leaderboard to receive extra prizes.

Good luck Dragoneers! 

[h1]Double XP event[/h1]

It’s time to get back into the arena and focus on your progression through all the available game modes with a new Double XP Event!

[b]Double XP is now live on ALL game modes, and will last until Monday 9th May at 13:00 UTC.

The rules are pretty simple: starting now until the end of the event, all the experience you will gain at the end of your matches will count as double. This x2 counter applies to your final count of XP on the summary screen visible at the end of your matches.[/b]

This also means all the XP Boosters you activate during this period will activate at the same rate on your scores, but grant you double the experience.

[i]It's the best time to make your way to the top in no time, so keep your riding skills sharp and see you in the skies![/i]

notes.title: The Colosseum
notes.content:
Come riders, come forth and master the challenges of The Colosseum!

Standing strong atop the treaterous cliffs of the Valkari league, the bloodstained doors of The Colosseum open to revive what were once the most unforgiving jousts of the whole continent. Its runite horns blow deep, inviting riders far and wide to partake in glorious battles, promising riches to the fiercest. Shall you heed the call, dragoneer?

[b]The Colosseum event will last until May 18th, 8:00 UTC.[/b]

Rules: Confront other dragon riders in variants of signature game modes and complete sets of challenges. Game mode variants will be active during the whole duration of the event, picked randomly during matchmaking.

- Kingslayer: this mode puts a twist on Carnage, where both teams have a dragoneer crowned King under Berserk. Earn points by eliminating the enemy King, and defend yours at all costs, your team score points when he complete his reign!

- Plunder: In this Spoils of War variant, risk daring heists as both teams can steal gold directly from the enemy coffers!

notes.title: Season 2: The Fate of Dragons
notes.content:
The time has finally come, dragonners. As Spring blooms life anew, Season 2 has taken root in Century with a nature-based character class and a treasure of new content. Full details below!

[b]Added content
[/b][list]
[*] Rider Class: Thornweaver
[*] Map: Eliean Càirn
[*] Dragon Pass with themed dragons, weapons, armour and more
[*] Story Arc unfolding in 8 Tomes
[*] Ranked Season
[/list]

[b]New Class: The Thornweaver[/b]
Living peacefully in a cradle of forest hidden from known civilisations, Thornweavers are an elite force who have sworn to keep the balance with nature and dragons. Their willowy sylvian composition and symbiosis with the elements allows them to summon elder forces, and unleash devastating Nature-based attacks upon their enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322267/051b59f6b64c3919b5643ae6270a5308604e83d4.png[/img]
Century's fifth character class can now be unlocked in the store for 800 Gems or 20,000 Iron Coins.

Abilities:
[list]
[*] Numbing Retaliation (Passive): Accumulates charges. Upon taking direct damage, releases slowing projectiles towards a nearby enemy based on the number of charges.
[*] Verdant Bulwark (Power): Enter a defensive stance, reducing incoming damage. Press the power button again to release poisonous spikes towards nearby enemies, up to 2 times.
[*] Verdant Bastion (Rage): Enhances Verdant Bulwark for a brief time, further reducing the damage you take, increasing your movement speed and allowing you to release unlimited poisonous spikes.
[*] Bramble Wall (Ability): Launches a projectile that releases a wall of thorns blocking your enemies' path. The Wall is released upon colliding with a surface, or pressing the ability button a second time when close to one.
[/list]

[b]New Dragons: the Vinedrakes[/b]
Season 2 also introduces a new species of dragons deeply intertwined with the new Thornweaver class. Vinedrakes acquire their particular shape through symbiosis with their rider, and don’t be fooled by their bark-like skin for its robustness and speed have brought many to their doom.

Many different variants of the Vinedrake roam the world of Century, and you’ll get the chance to tame them for the very first time through the Dragon Pass!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322267/c93ef7e1bf36cc964ddbdc50ff3fcda21cfc0f1d.jpg[/img]
Roaming freely in the backwoods of the Cradle, young Vinedrakes will sometimes hear a silent call coming from a Nassyan child ready for the Blooming Ritual. Upon completing it, a Thornweaver and their Vinedrake are bonded for life.


[b]Dragon Pass: A treasure of rewards[/b]
New season also means new loot! More than 70 themed rewards will be up for grabs through the Season 2 DragonPass, including epic and legendary dragons for all classes, weapons, armor pieces, player customisations and in-game currency.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322267/38dd902afc97cb7b4cf74b147b2988d908869ca6.png[/img]

This new Dragon Pass relies on the same system as the previous season, where you’ll have to complete missions to earn Levels and Stars. Levels will unlock the rewards tiers in the Dragon Pass, and stars can be spent to buy rewards. 


[b]New Map: Eilean Càirn[/b]
Players who have mastered the corridors of the Hünavatn Lake are up for a new challenge, as Season 2 introduces a overhaul of this classic map in the Eilean Càirn. This abandoned outpost reclaimed by nature is boasting open areas for high speed chases, tunnels for close quarter combat, air flow boosts and hiding areas for dragoneers to engage in their chosen battle patterns.
Our team has reshaped the fly paths with outgrown vegetation, which now makes this map a perfect hunting ground for those who will master the Thornweaver’s attacks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322267/2834dbaae3c3f09360fce427a15a967ff8786bf5.png[/img]

[b]The Lore of Season 2[/b]
This time, the story of Season 2 takes players to a whole different part of the continent and introduces two new civilizations that’ll play a key role in the future of relationships between riders and dragons. Each chapter of the lore will be available to everyone for free in the Dragon Pass interface and will unlock on a regular basis.

[i]“Dragons and humans maintain a sacred balance, woven centuries ago. But it only takes a spark to light a fire… Far in the northern cliffs of the Narairim Trench, an assembly of dissidents born from their ashes carries an extreme vision of dragoneering. Like a poison running deep through veins, their influence is spreading.
Hope resides on the shoulders of a tribe that once learned to live in symbiosis with dragons. Hidden in lush forests deep beyond the Kärsk Frontier, this peaceful civilization is now lost to the tides of time. Two worlds are about to collide, forging the fate of dragoneering for years to come.”[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322267/c99deb0d07ae5a342275016178b049baf6fb0160.png[/img]

[b]More to come[/b]
Season 2 will also introduce groundbreaking changes - including events, an overhaul of the acceleration, field of view and brake systems, a rework of the rage, HUD, and more. Additionally, players will be happy to know that we are leaning towards reintroducing an overarching progression path that would come on top of the seasonal progression. It’s currently under production and we will give more details as soon as we can.
As usual, we rely on your feedback to help us constantly improve everyone’s experience. We will even launch a community survey no later than this week to get your opinion on several potential events our team is currently designing.

We hope you’ll enjoy all the content of Season 2 and will be seeing you on the battlefield. Go, fly, burn your enemies and fight it out to bring back the peace between civilizations and dragons!

notes.title: Game Update - Permanent PvE
notes.content:
🔥 [b]01/02/23 Game Update - Permanent PvE[/b] 🔥

Hear ye hear ye Dragoneers, 

We are pleased to announce that the Outbreak PvE game mode is [b]back as a permanent game mode[/b] with more content! From now, both PvP and PvE will grow together and offer players the best of both worlds. But there’s more to this update… Including a Lunar New Year skin and UI upgrades. Read on for all the deets!

[b]PvE updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Outbreak game mode added to the permanent slots[/b]
[*] [b]New minion types: Blast & Bomber minions[/b]
[*] [b]New upgrade: Tower Heal Dragon[/b]
[*] [b]Reroll option in the upgrade shop[/b]
[/list]

[b]Other changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]New PvE daily missions[/b]
[*] [b]Class customization UI rework[/b]
[*] [b]Community Players Icons[/b] (available for free in the shop)
[*] [b]Tutorial tweaked[/b]
[*] [b]Shop readability upgrade[/b]
[*] [b]Lunar New Year skin[/b] (Windguard, Unique)
[*] [b]Wall damage is back![/b]
[/list]

We know that for PvE to become a continuously enjoyable mode in the long run we would need to add [b]more mobs variety[/b]… So behold two new frenemies: the Blast & Bomber minions! 💥
The first one will repel you when flying too close to it when it bursts, protecting its fellow invaders. The second one is more of a wandering bomb that can be useful when killed at the right time and at the right distance… 
Watch out for these two and use them wisely to overthrow the Parasite Queen.

We also want to make a deeper upgrade system, starting with the [b]Tower Heal Dragon[/b]: an upgrade that gives you a chance to meet a green ethereal dragon at the start of the next wave. If you catch them before they leave the map, your towers will get healed! 

Finally we wanted to add an option to avoid frustration of getting unneeded upgrades. From now on, you’ll be able to [b]reroll[/b] the shown upgrades! It will only cost you a bit of gold… A fair price for messing with fate! 🔮

Regarding the [b]tutorial[/b], as part of our ongoing efforts to better the new player experience, we have decided to make it shorter and more enjoyable. If you’re new to Century and do play it, let us know your thoughts.

We hope you enjoy the new Windguard skin as well as UI changes. Oh, and of course we did not forget about the long awaited community player icons, now available for free - and whilst they won’t stay forever in the shop, we plan to bring them back throughout the year.

Thank you again for your patience and your feedback! We’ll keep working on additional bug fixes while preparing the arrival of Season 2 and we hope you all enjoy what the skies will bring next! 🌠

Play as the Stormraiser and unleash the wrath of heavens on your enemies!
Stormraisers have the ability to unleash devastating thunder on their foes. Despite a tormenting past, they keep their oath to guard the Valkürian Sanctuary - the last line of defense against faraway foes.

notes.title: Crimson Spoils Event
notes.content:
[i]Folktales speak of Dragons who've roamed the lands far and wide for centuries. Some stayed true to their bloodthirsty line and terrorised populations, whilst others lived in harmony with nature and preserved the essence of life. But all stories have in common one thing: all dragons hoard gold. And we riders have found a way to make the best of it.
[/i]

[b]When does Crimson Spoils starts/ends?[/b]
The event runs from Friday 8th April 13:00 UTC, and ends Monday 18th April 13:00 UTC.

[b]What's the objective in Crimson Spoils?[/b]
Gather as much gold as you can in our signature game mode Spoils of War. Simple as that!

[b]What loot do I get?[/b]
[list]
[*] Daily Reward: each day at 00:00 UTC, gold collected is automatically transformed into Gems (up to 100 Gems/day). You can earn up to 1,100 Gems total through the course of the event.
[*] Returner Reward: complete your gold objective for at least 6 days (non consecutive) to be rewarded with a Legendary background.
[*] Competitive Reward: Secure a spot in the Top 100 / 500 / 1000 gold hoarders to earn yourself a set of rewards, the higher tier the better!
[/list]


Choose your strategy wisely and let your draconic urges take over to maximize your gains, dragoneer.

notes.title: Arena Changes, Elimination Mode, QoL Change
notes.content:
[b]🏟️ Arena Changes[/b]
As promised, we’re pleased to confirm the comeback of Gates of Fire mode in the Arena slot. To content all Dragoneers, Skirmish mode also joins GoF and Survival. We want to make sure players find their favorite game mode while ensuring we keep the best matchmaking experience possible. Therefore, we have implemented a threefold rotation, following the below pattern:

[list]
[*] Monday, Thursday, Saturday: Gates of Fire
[*] Tuesday, Friday : Skirmish
[*] Wednesday, Sunday : Survival	
[/list]

As an important reminder, this approach is temporary. We’re aiming to fully bring back all three modes 24/7 further down the road. 

[b]🎯 Experimental: Elimination 
[/b]
As some of you have experienced already, we’ll be bringing back the Experimental slot to test out a new approach to our existing game modes in the coming days.

This new game mode called “Elimination”, will be available for an entire week-end, replacing the Arena slot. The exact launch/end times will be confirmed at a later date. Obviously, you will have to not be a rookie anymore to play this mode, as the Experimental slot only appears to players at lvl 5 and higher. The Arena slot will return to its usual place following Monday as we gather your feedback on Elimination mode.

The Elimination mode will be based on a Carnage 3v3 setup with additional rules: 
[list]
[*] “Best of 7”: winning team is the first with 4 victorious rounds
[*] Death is permanent: the last team standing wins the round
[/list]

Communication, focus and strategy will be crucial for you to eliminate your enemies. So… let there be Carnage!!!



[b]✨ Quality of Life[/b]
Following our observations regarding game mode selection across the game, the behavior of the “Quickplay” button on the Lobby will be switched from auto-joining an Unranked match to the Play section - thus allowing everyone to select their preferred game mode.

We hope this slight change will direct more players to the Arena slot (Survival / Gates of Fire / Skirmish) and will be monitoring player counts and your feedback to continue improving your experience of Century.


As always, thanks for your devotion. We can’t wait to see you reduce your enemies into ashes in Elimination!

notes.title: Century: Age of Ashes - Patch Notes (15/12/2021)
SECOND CLOSED BETA IMPROVEMENTS & DATES
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have exciting news to share with you today! First of all, the update all of you were waiting for: our second closed beta will take place from March [b]12th to March 21st.[/b]

Here is a preview of what we will  add / improve, and before you ask : YES, you’ll be able to turn off/on the motion blur ;).

Also, note that your progression from the first closed beta has been reseted, but you will keep your progress after this second closed beta for Early Access. 

[b]Gates of Fire[/b]

The Gates of Fire mode didn’t create unanimity among you. So we decided to review it a bit to make it more balanced and thrilling. 

[list]
[*] Changing the number of rounds to a BO3 + an eventual 4th round in case of a draw, in order to avoid the exp draw exploit 
[*] Reviewing the sound design in order to make the game mode more epic
[*] Improve the balancing by adding more spawn emplacements for the flag, and make it appear a bit later after the start of a round 
[*] General UI / Fx  improvements to make the objectives clearer
[/list]

[b]Matchmaking & Game modes[/b]

A lot of you decided to stay on the Rookie mode until level 20 because it was a 3v3 mode on a smaller map. Unfortunately, this impacted the new players that were facing experienced Dragonners on their first games. We understand that getting stomped in your first games is not the best feeling.  

[list]
[*] Adding a MMR notion to the queue, and put same level players to the same games
[*] Rookie will be only accessible until level 10
[*] Adding the Skirmish mode : a BO5 3v3 game mode that will replace the Rookie mode for level 10 players and above. All the controls will be available at the first round.
[*] A Free Flight mode will be available. You’ll be able to familiarize yourself with the Dragon’s controls and play against an enemy bot.
[/list]


[b]Other Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Adding a penalty system for the leavers 
[*] The shop will be open! You’ll be able to spend your earned currencies, but won’t be able to pay with real money
[*] Leaderboard will be available 
[*] Global ping improvement
[*] Improving the Mouse / Keyboard controls
[*] General sound design improvements to improve the sensation when you hit an enemy
[*] Progression system has been rebalanced. We want the level up system to feel like an accomplishment
[/list]

We know that a lot of you will be disappointed, but you won’t be able to pet your dragons.
Dragon petting is not something “vital” for our game launch, since it doesn’t impact the general gameplay. But we know that you want to bond more with your mount, that’s why we are highly considering it my a future update. 

Also, you noticed that since the second closed beta will be in March, the early access won’t be in February, as announced. We are a small team, and quality is important for us. That’s why we took the decision to postpone the early access to the first week of April. 

We hope that we will be able to meet your expectations and are thrilled to start this adventure with you. You are now 2,500 on this server, and more than 60,000 people requested access to the Playtest. And it’s just the beginning!

notes.title: Happy New Year! Here is the latest information about Century!
notes.content:
[b]First thing first, Happy New Year from the Playwing team! We hope you had a good holiday season and that you will continue to follow us throughout 2021! Today we're going to talk about what to expect from Century: Age of Ashes in terms of content.[/b]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/2yyp9fqw/Title-Elmt-Center.png[/img]

[h2]A game made with love[/h2]

Century: Age of Ashes is the project of a small team based in Bordeaux, France. Playwing is made up of around thirty developers who have been working for nearly two and a half years on this project which is very close to their hearts. Our approach to development has been to work on a solid foundation which will be built upon over the months. That's why we chose Steam Early Access, to improve the experience based on your feedback.

When the game will launch in February, there will be three classes to choose from: Marauder, Windguard, and Phantom. That means three gameplay styles, but also different synergies that we created thanks to a subtle balance. There will also be three big maps (Hünavatn Lake, Fjalnärr Basin and Aldrün Sanctuary), and three game modes (Carnage, Raid, Survival). For each of these contents, the philosophy was simple: quality rather than quantity. We prefer to publish fun and polished updates, rather than filling the game with half-baked content...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322267/d3c0637ed52fa90cce2c45b08be3629a5dc2da75.png[/img]

[h2]Early Access[/h2]

Even if a lot of additional content is already planned, Century: Age of Ashes will still be a Steam Early Access game with a limited content at launch. Additional game modes, classes and maps will enhance the experience and will be created based on your feedback. To help us in this mission, please share your suggestions on [url=https://twitter.com/playcentury]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://discord.com/invite/YrPhGpNT9r]Discord[/url] - we try to answer you as much as possible!

At Playwing, we strongly believe in building a video game based on the expectations and requests of gamers. This is also why the Century: Age of Ashes Early Access should be viewed as a solid first foundation, not a game full of content.

[h2]And now?[/h2]

Since we like to accompany our news with a fresh video, this week we want to share the work of our talented composer, [url=https://twitter.com/TrendOrchestra]Marcus Hedges[/url]. He just published one of the wonderful tracks he wrote for Century, we hope you will enjoy it! We've also posted a bunch of wallpapers on [url=https://imgur.com/gallery/0fzcSKU]Imgur[/url]!

As for the next deadlines, get ready to discover the gameplay of the game in detail in the coming days, as we're working on the gameplay trailer. See you in late January for the launch of the first Closed Beta! Please follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/playcentury]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/PlayCenturyAOA/]Facebook[/url], and [url=https://discord.com/invite/YrPhGpNT9r]Discord[/url] for more information!

[previewyoutube=sgFUjQJ7iQM;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Happy Holidays! We’ll back in January for the Beta!
notes.content:
[b]It's Christmas season, our dragons have put on their winter coats and we are slowly preparing our game for the January beta. To end 2020 on a high note, we just published our first Dev Diary recorded in the Playwing studio in Bordeaux.[/b]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/2yyp9fqw/Title-Elmt-Center.png[/img]

[h2]Welcome to Playwing![/h2]

We are a young studio and while our team includes many industry veterans, you certainly don't know us. To help you better understand who the people behind [i]Century: Age of Ashes[/i] are, we have made this first Dev Diary starring Pascal and Emmanuel. They are the fathers of the game and the heads of the development team that has been working on the project for a little over two years.

In addition to showing you our studio, this video is here to explain the origin of the project and the goals of the whole team. What are the ambitions behind this project? What are the influences of the developers? What content will be available at launch? You will find answers to all these questions and new gameplay clips in our first Dev Diary!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322267/2e79aa70c92ca6102da4208b5afb1ab6640c31b1.png[/img]

[h2]Happy Holidays![/h2]

2020 has been a tough year and we wish you a happy holiday season! We ourselves will put our dragons away for a few days in order to prepare for January. Next month we will be opening the doors to the Closed Beta - an important moment for the whole team, as this is the first time we will let the public play our game!

Once again, we will do our best to satisfy all players who have requested access, but this will have to be done little by little to avoid technical problems. If you don't get access during this first test session, don't worry, a second session will follow shortly after. Please follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/playcentury]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/PlayCenturyAOA/]Facebook[/url], and [url=https://discord.com/invite/YrPhGpNT9r]Discord[/url] for more information!

[b]Merry Christmas from the Playwing Team![/b]

[previewyoutube=lXtKTk2ziVM;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Thank You Dragoneers! New Trailers and Closed Beta Information Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[b]What a week! Last Thursday we revealed [i]Century: Age of Ashes[/i] during The Game Awards pre-show and your response was fantastic. Many of you have joined us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/YrPhGpNT9r]Discord[/url], asked questions on [url=https://twitter.com/playcentury]Twitter[/url], and wishlisted the game on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/918570/Century_Age_of_Ashes/]Steam[/url]. On behalf of the entire Playwing team, thank you very much! We can’t wait to see you in the skies![/b]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/2yyp9fqw/Title-Elmt-Center.png[/img]

[h2]Let's talk about the future![/h2]

With this wonderful community gathered around our project, we receive a lot of extremely interesting questions every day. Want to know everything about [i]Century: Age of Ashes[/i]? We can’t wait to share more! Here's what to expect in the next few weeks.

Starting in January, we will unveil more information about the gameplay with new trailers. In the coming gameplay trailer, we’ll be showing off game modes, a lot of gameplay mechanics, the classes you can choose from, and many other features. For example, one of the best ways to launch into the skies is to ride columns of wind scattered throughout the map—a fantastic way to escape pursuers and gain strategic advantages! Keep eyed riders will spot this and many other features shown!

We’ll also be releasing another video more fully introducing each of the classes available when we launch [i]Century: Age of Ashes[/i] into Closed Beta and Early Access. Windguard, Phantom, Marauder all have their individual strengths and this trailer will share more details about the abilities of each class, their role in a team, and the synergies you can create with them. Since each class is made up of a rider and a dragon, we'll also be covering some of the skins and customization options in more detail. Are you ready to discover some legendary dragons!? Here’s a sneak peek!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322267/0648277778afc10a97a0a5ca54c0d94d40497e16.png[/img]

[h2]What to expect from the beta?[/h2]

The first Closed Beta will launch mid-to-late January. This will be a big step for us as it is the first time we will let a large number of players try our beloved project.

If you've been in betas before, you know that no game is free of technical issues. This is why we want to test and move carefully. During the first beta, we know we will not be able to satisfy all players who have requested access. As keen dragon fans ourselves, we appreciate your enthusiasm, but we need to be sure of Century's level of stability before opening the doors wide. The team here at Playwing wants your first experience with [i]Century: Age of Ashes[/i] to be as amazing as possible. 

If you don't get access during this first test session, don't worry, a second session will follow shortly after. We plan to welcome more people and even offer a reward to thank players for participating in the playtest… More on that later!

[h2]Want more?[/h2]

Follow [i]Century: Age of Ashes[/i] on social media for the latest news. We’ll be sharing more about the game, new gameplay clips, and answering questions, on [url=https://twitter.com/playcentury]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/PlayCenturyAOA/]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/playcentury_/]Instagram[/url]. Want to get involved with the community? Join us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/YrPhGpNT9r]Discord[/url]! This is the perfect place to ask questions, talk about the game (or other topics), and discover some incredible fan art!

You can also help us by wishlisting the game on Steam!

See you next week, Dragoneers!

[previewyoutube=21T_6N_uYHo;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The Century: Age of Ashes Closed Beta starts in January!
notes.content:
[b][i]Century: Age of Ashes[/i] was announced during The Game Awards 2020 pre-show! We are so glad you finally have the opportunity to see what the Playwing Bordeaux team has been working on for years. Dragons, online battles, fun and accessible team gameplay… these are the ingredients of our first PC game which will launch in Steam Early Access in February. Want to join us in the arena earlier? Sign up for the Closed Beta![/b]
 
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/TwqTXJVk/GIF-CP3.gif[/img]

[h2]When will the [i]Century: Age of Ashes[/i] Closed Beta begin?[/h2]

The Closed Beta will start in January, but you can request access on Steam through the Playtest feature. We will announce more specific dates in the coming weeks. Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/playcentury]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/PlayCenturyAOA/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://discord.com/invite/YrPhGpNT9r]Discord[/url] and [url=https://www.century-age-of-ashes.com/]the official website[/url] to make sure you don’t miss anything!

[h2]How do I apply for the [i]Century: Age of Ashes[/i] Closed Beta?[/h2]

It’s very simple, just go to the game’s Steam page and click on the “Request Access” button.

[list]
[*] Launch your Steam app and sign in with your account.
[*] Type “[i]Century: Age of Ashes[/i]” in the search bar or click on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/918570/Century_Age_of_Ashes/]this link[/url].
[*] Click on the “Request Access” button.
[*] Done! We will send you an invitation when we need more testers.
[/list]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/hP9tBxnQ/join.png[/img]

[h2]When will I receive my closed beta invitation?[/h2]

If you don’t receive an invitation in January, don’t worry, there will be additional testing sessions ahead of the Early Access release in February. We are working hard to let everyone try [i]Century: Age of Ashes[/i], but we also need to consider the number of requests and the ability of the game to withstand a massive influx of players. We will do our best to be clear about the number of invitations sent and when the next session will start. Please follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/playcentury]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/PlayCenturyAOA/]Facebook[/url], and [url=https://discord.com/invite/YrPhGpNT9r]Discord[/url] for more information.

[h2]Will my closed beta progress carry over to launch?[/h2]

No, gameplay elements may change before the Early Access release in February and we want everyone to start at the same level.

[h2]Will the store be available during the Beta phase?[/h2]

No, it will not be possible to purchase additional content from the [i]Century: Age of Ashes[/i] store prior to the Early Access release.

[previewyoutube=21T_6N_uYHo;full][/previewyoutube]
